speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me when your gait instability and limb ataxia first began, and did they develop suddenly or gradually over time?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision or difficulty speaking, and have you experienced any recent headaches? Do you have a history of alcohol use or any previous neurological conditions?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of Crohn's disease and recent natalizumab use, are you experiencing any new fevers, severe fatigue, or a general feeling of being unwell? I need to know if you have noticed any changes in your memory or personality alongside these motor symptoms.

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had a recent fever or major infection that I know of. The symptoms are mostly gait imbalance, limb ataxia, and weaker use of my right arm.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of shingles or other viral infections in the past, and have you noticed any recent visual disturbances like blurred vision or loss of vision? Given your symptoms and natalizumab use, I need to rule out Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy, so REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain with contrast.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Vital Signs: Temperature Normothermic, Blood Pressure Within normal range, Heart Rate Within normal range, Respiratory Rate Within normal range. Neurological Examination: Gait Assessment shows Ataxic gait noted; Right Upper Limb Strength is 4/5; Coordination Tests show Evidence of ataxia. MRI Brain: Findings show Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). Comments: T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.

speaker: Doctor
text: The MRI findings confirm multifocal demyelinating lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML), a serious complication associated with your natalizumab use. Given these definitive results, I will proceed with your diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).
